transcript:
Meeting header: 2026-03-10 09:30 PT | Duration: 45m | Attendees: Evan, Theo, Maya, Chris, Alyssa, Samir, Priya, Lina

Summary/Context: Internal ops sync; billing ops and security need alignment ahead of Q2 audits and monthly invoicing. Runbook for rotating customer-facing KMS keys (and service account keys) needs sign-off.

Links referenced: runbook draft - https://redwood.internal/runbooks/key-rotation-draft (note: internal link), billing tag spreadsheet - https://redwood.internal/billing/reports/mtd-tags, SOC2 artifact index - https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2-index

00:00 Evan: okay thanks everyone for joining on short notice, uh we'll try to keep this to 45. quick round robin — Theo can you kick off with status on the key rotation playbook?
00:28 Theo: yeah sure, um so I pushed the initial playbook to the runbooks repo last night. it has the sequence: snapshot KV cache, rotate KMS key (AWS K M S), update service account creds, then restart relevant pods. most steps are manual right now but there's a terraform + vault snippet placeholder. note: the snippet is rough, missing the HSM/CloudHSM hooks.
01:15 Samir: when you say KV cache snapshot you mean the LLM KV cache, right? like the prefix cache we use in production? just clarifying cause if we flush wrong thing we'll invalidate warm caches and spike costs.
01:38 Theo: yes exactly, sorry bad shorthand. i mean the runtime KV cache snapshots so we can warm back. we'll coordinate a short freeze window to allow warmup.
01:55 Maya: also, remember the staging env doesn't fully replicate the dedicated pools so we might miss some perf regressions in stage. can we include a smoke test for latency and throughput?
02:10 Theo: plan is to run the smoke script that hits 3 model routes and measures median p95 — i'll include that.
02:38 Chris: from IT side i want the rotate schedule to be at low traffic times and also a fallback plan that doesn't require manual key re-import. we need an automated rollback.
03:02 Evan: yeah rollback is critical. Theo, include both automated rollback using previous key alias and a manual set of steps if aliases fail.
03:18 Priya: shifting to billing, we need the month-to-date export with tags — Alyssa sent me an example last quarter but the tagging is inconsistent across teams. if the tags aren't normalized we can't chargeback correctly.
03:40 Alyssa: correct. my ask is one canonical list of chargeback tags plus owner per tag. then Priya can produce an export that maps invoices to teams.
04:05 Priya: i'll run tag normalization heuristics and surface ambiguous tags. question: do we have an agreed owner list?
04:22 Alyssa: Ops owners are here — I'll take ops tags, SRE is Theo for infra, Platform is Evan for runtime, Product gets a subset — i'll send mapping after the call.
04:38 Lina: quick compliance note — auditors prefer a single folder with indexed artifacts and hashes where possible. can we make sure the GDrive link is immutable (or at least versioned) and that proofs include TTLs and retention policy?
05:05 Samir: yes i'll consolidate artifacts and include checksums. also need to capture who accessed the artifacts for audit logs.
05:25 Evan: good. any blockers for the rotation dry-run? Theo?
05:35 Theo: main blocker is the playbook missing the HSM commands for key import/rotation. if we don't have CloudHSM access scripted we need manual steps.
05:52 Samir: we have HSM access via the security team; Samir will share the short CLI sequence for import.
06:03 Samir: i can share a step-by-step but i'm not dropping creds in chat, obviously. i'll put it in the runbook and mark it restricted.
06:20 Maya: also note we need Okta mappings for service accounts — sometimes SSO groups grant unintended roles and that causes failed redeploys after rotation. can someone review the mapping?
06:35 Chris: I will run an access review for service accounts this week and flag any cross-team privileges.
06:47 Evan: perfect. let's surface the likely outage window — what about Saturday 02:00 PT? low traffic.
07:00 Theo: Saturday 02:00 PT is fine for staging, for prod i recommend a shorter window, maybe 30 minutes, and immediate rollback if errors exceed 5% error rate on the smoke tests.
07:22 Alyssa: for billing, to avoid confusion i'd like rotations to be scheduled around invoice cycles; if a rotate accidentally changes tagging metadata we want it isolated. not sure that's likely but let's be cautious.
07:45 Priya: noted. i'll ensure billing snapshots are taken prior to the rotation and that the export includes a pre/post comparison.
08:03 Evan: great. action items recap will be in the notes. any other risks?
08:10 Samir: one more — we must rotate keys for any long-lived service accounts that have embedded creds in old automation. those are often forgotten; we should run a scan for stale creds.
08:26 Theo: I can run the automation scan on Friday. it will list any service account tokens older than 90 days.
08:38 Lina: and for SOC2 we need proof of rotation schedule and that it actually ran. perhaps a rotation log entry with a signature. we'll need signed artifacts.
08:52 Samir: yes, add an audit log hook to the playbook that writes a rotation manifest to the compliance index.
09:05 Evan: okay, switching back to billing — Priya, can you share the MTD export by EOD Tuesday?
09:12 Priya: yes EOD Tuesday works.
09:20 Alyssa: i'll review and send the canonical tag-owner map by Monday.
09:28 Evan: for the dry run Theo and Samir will coordinate — please allow two hours for prep and a 30-min execution window.
09:40 Theo: noted. i'll create a runbook PR with the smoke tests and the rollback thresholds.
09:47 Maya: small note on comms — we should have a single slack channel for the dry-run and an incident channel template in case of issues.
09:59 Chris: I'll create the channels and invite the group.
10:10 Evan: perfect. let's do a quick recap of next steps...
10:22 (recap followed by brief confirmations)

Closing:
Evan: thanks everyone. I'll send the runbook link and calendar invites for the dry-run. We'll meet after the dry-run to capture lessons and close gaps.

Transcript notes: transcription was generated by Fireflies and lightly edited; some technical acronyms may be garbled (e.g., CloudHSM sometimes appears as Cloud H S M, KMS as K M S). There are a few overlaps/crosstalk segments between Theo and Samir.
